label: early original-phase c/3 input (t=3-4) after c/3/2/d-like token, in sequences starting r/j/k/z
explanation: Very sparse unit (~0.03% of steps, ~760 sequences). Fires only in the original phase at t=3-5 (70% of mass at t=3, 28% at t=4, none at t<3, t>5, delimiter, or copy). The input token is almost always c or 3 (90% of mass), sometimes d or l. Fires more often and more strongly when the first token is r or j (k, z, p less so) and the previous token is c, 3, 2 or d (x, l, v less so). So it acts as a sparse conjunction of position, current token and prefix tokens, not one clean concept. The coarse condition (t in 3-4, input c/3) gets 88% of mass but only 2.5% precision. Adding the first-token and previous-token sets gives dev F1 0.50 and mass recall 0.70. The top activations (r/j-initial sequences, c or 3 at t=3) are covered best. The token lists were fit to the data.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=j (+3.68), prev_tok=3 (+3.49), prev_tok=2 (+3.42), orig0=r (+3.31), t=3 & prev_tok=c (+2.76), phase=0 & in_tok=c (+2.75). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-1.79), prev2_tok=j (-1.60), prev2_tok=b (-1.47).
